description:
Priority: P2 (build). File: build.rs. Reference: metricstore.

Problem: The shared build.rs warns on every local build when VCS/CI-CD provenance env vars are absent, spamming local dev.

Change: Only emit the cargo:warning=... when env::var_os("CI").is_some(), and add println!("cargo:rerun-if-env-changed=CI");

Acceptance: local cargo build is warning-free; CI still warns when provenance is missing.
title: [TPL-019] Refine build.rs to gate the "unknown" warning behind CI
